items.description: Ciudad Juárez is a border city in northern Mexico, known for its maquiladoras and vibrant cultural exchange with the US.
Saltillo is the capital of Coahuila state, famous for its dinosaur fossils and sarape weaving traditions.
Mayapán is a post-Classic Maya archaeological site in Yucatán, once a major political and cultural center.
Chapultepec Zoo in Mexico City is one of the oldest and largest zoos globally, home to a wide array of species.
San Juan de Aragón Zoo in Mexico City focuses on native fauna conservation and environmental education.
Guadalajara Zoo is a leading zoo in Mexico, featuring modern facilities and successful conservation programs.
Acuario Inbursa in Mexico City is one of Latin America's largest aquariums, showcasing diverse marine life.
Xcaret Park in Riviera Maya is an eco-archaeological theme park blending nature, culture, and adventure.
Africam Safari in Puebla is a drive-through safari park where animals roam freely in natural habitats.
Bioparque Estrella is a large wildlife park in Mexico offering safari tours and various animal encounters.
The Monarch Butterfly Biosphere Reserve is a UNESCO World Heritage site, winter home to millions of monarch butterflies.
Sian Ka'an is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in Yucatán, featuring Mayan ruins, mangroves, and diverse wildlife.
Calakmul Biosphere Reserve in Campeche is one of Mexico's largest and best-preserved rainforest areas.
